Grandpa's rule (wisdom, not law)

Up north the map is the law. Know your zone letter, your elevation and your road before you leave the truck.

Common mistakes
  • Shooting a Haida Gwaii deer and carrying 6 in the freezer. Possession is 5.
  • Taking a snowmobile to hunt in 6-9 in January. Hunting from it is banned there all year.
  • Shooting a near white black bear on the coast. White and blue phases are closed.
